Medicine Department

Monday, December 20, 2021

Medicine conference on the theme, "Clinical problem solving" 2022

Medicine Conference with the theme "Clinical problem solving 2022" focuses on the idea of ‘patient centered medical cognition’ and features fascinating and inspiring content from speakers supported by global experts, covering key areas in medicine. 


The conference is aimed to  serve as a platform for the medicine community to share best practices, acquire knowledge, and debate innovative approaches for "clinical problem solving" together.

SREEPURAM, NARKETPALLY, NALGONDA (DIST) – 508254


Hosted by the DEPARTMENT OF GENERAL MEDICINE
